sentences.en: The other is just sort of saying, well, you're doing this and I am not going to get angry because I'm not going to, I'm going to let you do that and, and be patient and take it in
sentences.zh: 另一种只是说，好吧，你正在这样做，但我不会生气，因为我不会，我会让你那样做，并且，保持耐心，接受它，

sentences.zh: 我，我，我，我，我，我知道，我想我知道该做什么和不该做什么，无论是在家里，还是在餐馆，或者在公共场合，等等。

sentences.en: I, I, I, first thing I do is I don't go out if I don't think I can meet people well.
sentences.zh: 我，我，我，我做的第一件事就是，如果我觉得我不能很好地与人相处，我就不出门。

sentences.zh: 那是一个选择。

sentences.zh: 当我见到某人时，我，

sentences.en: I, uh, I, I, I, I don't want to say it because I still love him and, and I don't want to, um,
sentences.zh: 我，呃，我，我，我，我不想说，因为我仍然爱他，而且我不想，嗯，

sentences.zh: 绝对会。

sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Though that's.

sentences.zh: 那么如果你不经常表演，你会做什么？

sentences.zh: 因为我知道过去你说过类似的话，你知道，你需要表演才能生活。

sentences.zh: 那么你，你，你将如何填补那个空间？

sentences.zh: 大卫，再说一次，我的一切都是为了我的幼儿。

sentences.en: I mean, I, that she, um, takes 80% of my energy and I'm focused on that.
sentences.zh: 我是说，她，嗯，占据了我80%的精力，我专注于此。

sentences.en: So, um, I'm, there's, it's not about how, how can I fill the time?

sentences.zh: 更多的是关于，我能否找到时间去陪伴她、培养她，并，并，并引导她。

sentences.en: Um, and I'm lucky right now because she's young enough that as long as we can travel together and I can come home to her, that's good.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我很幸运，因为她还小，只要我们能一起旅行，我能回家陪她，那就很好。

sentences.en: But, uh, yeah, that is, um, on my mind how I'm going to, uh,
sentences.zh: 但是，呃，是的，我确实在想，我将如何，呃，

sentences.en: compartmentalize my time.
sentences.zh: 把我的时间进行拆分管理。

sentences.zh: 最后一个问题，我知道在你职业生涯早期，你对……很感兴趣

sentences.zh: 那种围绕自己打造神话的想法，有点像要成为一个传奇人物。

sentences.en: I think you're looking quizzical.
sentences.zh: 我看你一脸困惑。

sentences.en: Is that not the case?
sentences.zh: 不是这样吗？

sentences.en: No, I'm thinking about it.
sentences.zh: 不，我是在思考。

sentences.en: I'm thinking about what you're asking me and I'm putting,
sentences.zh: 我在思考你问我的问题，并且在……

sentences.en: I'm connecting the dots.
sentences.zh: 我在把这些点串联起来。

sentences.en: And, you know, whether you realize it or not, you've definitely have achieved that and, and are
sentences.zh: 而且，不管你有没有意识到，你确实做到了这一点，并且在……

sentences.en: to a lot of people, a kind of larger than life character or figure in the way that other kind
sentences.zh: 在很多人眼中，你已经成为了一种传奇式的人物或形象，就像那种……

sentences.en: of older Hollywood, uh, icons might be, I think of somebody like, you know, like a Dennis Hopper or something or a Brando sort of reputation precedes them in a way.
sentences.zh: 好莱坞的老牌偶像，比如丹尼斯·霍珀或者马龙·白兰度那样，名声总是先于本人到来。

sentences.en: And they have a mythology around them.
sentences.zh: 他们身上自带一种神话色彩。

sentences.en: And I, I want to know like, what's been, what was, what was good about achieving that?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，做到这一点，有什么……什么是好的方面？

sentences.en: And, and what was more challenging?
sentences.zh: 又有什么是更具挑战性的？

sentences.en: Because you might be larger than life, but I was thinking, well, it's your life that, that you're living, that the other people are, are viewing.
sentences.zh: 因为你可能确实成了传奇，但我当时在想，毕竟这是你正在过的生活，而其他人只是在旁观。

sentences.en: That's a really, um, uh, profound, I think, question because I, I'm still trying to find my answer to it and it's pretty deep.
sentences.zh: 这真是一个……嗯……深刻的问题，我觉得，因为我还在寻找答案，这确实很深奥。

sentences.en: Um, yes, when I began, I wanted to cultivate this mythology around myself.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，刚开始的时候，我确实想在自己身上培养这种神话感。

sentences.en: That was before we had this thing called the internet.
sentences.zh: 那是在我们有互联网这种东西之前。

sentences.en: And I didn't know that it would go that far, that it would be that widespread.
sentences.zh: 我当时并不知道它会走得那么远，会传播得那么广。

sentences.en: Did I think, could, I didn't have the means to imagine that one day it would become this thing we call memes or would go into different cultures around
sentences.zh: 我当时根本没有能力想象，有一天它会变成我们现在所说的“迷因”（梗图），或者传播到世界各地的不同文化中，

sentences.en: the world or whatever it is that the internet deploys.
sentences.zh: 或者互联网所散布的任何东西。

sentences.en: So I think it, it went beyond what I initially was trying to cultivate, uh, a mystique and aura and enigmatic presence, a mystery,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为它超越了我最初试图培养的东西，那种神秘感、光环、难以捉摸的存在感，那种神秘，

sentences.en: all that beautiful stuff that the, um, black and white golden age, as we call them, uh,
sentences.zh: 所有那些美好的特质，那些……嗯……我们所说的黑白黄金时代，

sentences.en: Bogarts and Cagney's, Betty Davis's had before, um, there was so much television and certainly before the internet.
sentences.zh: 像鲍嘉、卡格尼、贝蒂·戴维斯在电视普及之前，当然更是在互联网出现之前所拥有的那种特质。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I guess another way of putting it would be what was gained in, in achieving the goal of developing a personal mythology and what was lost?
sentences.zh: 我想换个说法，在实现打造个人神话这个目标的过程中，得到了什么，又失去了什么？

sentences.en: Well, I, I think that there may have become, um, you know, it's like I grew up watching David Carradine and Kung Fu and I saw
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想可能出现了一种……你知道，就像我从小看大卫·卡拉丹的《功夫》长大，我看到

sentences.en: him in a movie and he didn't do any Kung Fu and I was disappointed.
sentences.zh: 他在某部电影里没打功夫，我就很失望。

sentences.en: And so maybe there's an element of like, gosh, I really want to see Nick go off the rails and I'm not going to give them that every time.
sentences.zh: 所以可能存在这样一种因素，天哪，我真的很想看尼克失控的样子，但我不可能每次都满足他们。

sentences.en: And I hope they're not disappointed, you know?
sentences.zh: 我希望他们不会失望，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And what was the good thing about it?
sentences.zh: 那这件事好的一面是什么呢？

sentences.en: About having achieved the goal that you set out for yourself in your early twenties?
sentences.zh: 关于实现了你在二十出头时为自己设定的目标？

sentences.en: David, it wasn't the goal.
sentences.zh: 大卫，那不是目标。

sentences.en: The goal was to create that mystery, that enigmatic aura.
sentences.zh: 目标是创造那种神秘感，那种难以捉摸的光环。

sentences.en: This is something else that I had no reference point that it would happen.
sentences.zh: 这是另一回事，我完全没预料到会发生这种事。

sentences.en: And so I'm still trying to, so what, can I say that what's the good thing?
sentences.zh: 所以我还在试图……那么，我能说什么是好的一面吗？

sentences.en: Um, the good thing is it kept me in the zeitgeist or it kept me in the conversation for better or for worse, but is it perfect for me?
sentences.zh: 嗯，好的一面是它让我保持在时代精神之中，或者说让我一直处于话题中心，无论好坏，但这对我来说是完美的吗？

sentences.en: No, because that's not what the movie's necessarily about.
sentences.zh: 不，因为电影本身并不一定是为了那个。

sentences.en: That little two second moment, if you really want to see how the character got there, you need to watch the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 那短短两秒钟的片段，如果你真的想看角色是如何走到那一步的，你需要看完整个故事。

sentences.en: It's not just little screenshots of little gifs or whatever they call them.
sentences.zh: 它不仅仅是那些小截图、小动图或者随便什么叫法的东西。

sentences.en: It's, it's something building to that eruption, if you will.
sentences.zh: 它是某种东西在酝酿，直到那一刻爆发，如果你愿意这么说的话。

sentences.en: And so maybe it's lost, you know, because now you hear all this conversation about attention spans and they're getting reduced and no one has time for that.
sentences.zh: 所以也许这就是失去的东西，你知道，因为现在你听到所有关于注意力持续时间的讨论，它们正在缩短，没人有时间看那些。

sentences.en: So now they're just seeing, you don't say, or what, you know, so I don't know if that's what I had in mind.
sentences.zh: 所以现在他们只看到“你不会吧”或者什么的，你知道，所以我不知道这是否是我当初所想的。

sentences.zh: 我没想过什么短视频片段或动图。
